Definition
[product sphere metric $S^n_a\times S^m_b$]

Source: petersen:page-0135, petersen:page-0136

For $a,b>0$, $S^n_a\times S^m_b:=S^n(1/\sqrt a)\times S^m(1/\sqrt b)$, with metric $g=\tfrac 1a ds_n^2+\tfrac 1b ds_m^2$ on $S^n\times S^m$.
